Question_text: The diagram shows the fixed costs, variable costs and total costs of a firm at output S. Which distance represents the firm's variable costs?
image: A cost curve diagram with 'costs' on the y-axis and 'output' on the x-axis. A horizontal line from the origin (O) up to point R on the y-axis represents Fixed Costs. A line starting from R and sloping upwards passes through point Q at output S, representing Total Costs. The vertical distance from O to Q is the total cost at output S. The vertical distance from O to R is the fixed cost. The variable costs at output S are represented by the vertical distance from R to Q (RQ).
